verdict.rationale: Explaining why a transaction scored as risky is a fair question for a fraud-decisioning product like Signifyd, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that the Get Decision API and webhooks return or announce a fraud/guarantee decision. Nothing documents that each score comes with its top risk factors, reason codes or any other explanation.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, every score comes with its top risk factors — why this transaction looks risky — not just an opaque number
